method: Four reference-bound ten-pose sheets were generated. Queen required two image_gen revisions (matte, then uniform in-cell reduction for wider gutters); Ravager required four (matte, uniform in-cell reduction, matte, then crisp opaque contour re-render). Rejected candidates remain outside the repository. PNGs remain unmodified outside image_gen: no procedural cleanup, drawing, recoloring, resizing or pose synthesis. Read-only measurements and diagnostic previews do not alter the admitted files.
historicalAssets: No V188 atlas or original project plate was changed.

fidelity.verifiedScope: Visual consistency with four active fan-made project plates, ten key poses per identity, anatomy-specific primary contact attacks and prone final KOs. Measured alpha boundaries, supports and fixed per-identity scale are separately verified by the atlas contract. These drawings do not verify canonical body measurements, original frame timing or complete motion choreography.

images.exactInitialPrompt:
Create a NEW production-ready game sprite atlas, using the ONE supplied character plate as the strict identity reference. Produce EXACTLY TEN FULL-BODY DRAWINGS of THAT SAME organism, in a regular FIVE-COLUMN by TWO-ROW layout, read left to right, then top to bottom. Use a wide transparent canvas around 2560x1024 (5:2 aspect ratio). Every cell has exactly ONE whole organism, generous empty transparent gutters (at least 8–12% on all sides), no overlapping neighboring sprites and absolutely NO clipped head crests, tail tips, horns, blades, hands, claws or feet. True transparent RGBA background. No solid backdrop, checkerboard baked into the picture, vignette, floor, cast shadows, text, numbers, labels, cell borders, colored particle noise, aura, splash, projectile or effects. Preserve the exact distinctive anatomy, proportions, color palette and retro detailed painted-sprite shading of this source plate. Do not redesign into a generic xenomorph and do not change the rendering style. Every pose is side-view or the same shallow side angle as the reference and FACES RIGHT.
ONE CONSTANT ORGANISM SCALE ACROSS ALL TEN CELLS: keep the skull, armor and limb lengths the same in pixel size. Never stretch, enlarge or miniaturize short/crouching/prone poses to fill a cell. Bend the tail naturally within the empty gutter if needed, never shorten or crop it. All supported lowest body points align on the same invisible support baseline near 90% of cell height. Leave empty pixels beneath and around them, without ground marks.
The specified anatomy-appropriate PRIMARY CONTACT ATTACK is defined below; these drawings MUST NOT depict its projectile/special/super.
TEN POSES, EXACT ORDER:
TOP ROW 1 idle neutral alert stance; 2 walk contact A with near legs/feet placed forward; 3 walk contact B with opposite limbs forward, genuinely distinct contact from pose2; 4 primary contact attack anticipation, body braced and attacking part pulled back; 5 primary contact attack impact, attacking anatomy extended to the RIGHT, controlled support, same skull/body scale as idle.
BOTTOM ROW 6 primary attack recovery, attacking anatomy returning and weight settling, visibly distinct from idle; 7 defensive guard/bracing anatomically appropriate to this organism; 8 hit recoil with torso/head reacting backward and joints bending while retaining the exact identity; 9 KO falling/collapse, body visibly lowering through folding legs and/or elbows and lowered head, NOT a standing sprite simply rotated; 10 KO final, COMPLETE SIDEWAYS LYING POSE: torso/shoulder/hip and skull resting horizontally low along the invisible support line, limbs naturally folded, long tail resting low. Preserve all anatomy intact and recognizable, no explosion, dismemberment, gore or extra body parts. In the last cell the organism is genuinely fully prone, not kneeling/crouching/standing. Ten real changed poses, not copies or mirrored duplicates.

IDENTITY LOCK: the mobile Alien QUEEN in the supplied plate. Very tall imposing BLUE-BLACK biomechanical royal body, HUGE elongated swept-back fan/crown HEAD CREST with the same pointed rays and ridges as this source, angular toothed face, tall digitigrade hind legs, TWO LONG MAIN ARMS ending in large fine claws AND a DISTINCT SEPARATE PAIR OF SMALL THORACIC ARMS below the rib cage. Keep ALL FOUR ARMS present in every cell, including folded on the prone body. Preserve the long thick segmented tail with its pointed blade tip, and the dorsal spines. Do not turn her into a two-armed Warrior, quadrupedal Crusher, scorpion, red Prowler or ovipositor-bound queen. The PRIMARY ATTACK is a reach and slash by one of the LONG MAIN FORECLAWS (not the tail): windup draws that forearm back, impact reaches right, recovery returns. The small arms stay visibly tucked near the chest. Guard braces the long claws in front of the lower torso. For KO final, the entire huge crest is sideways near the ground, body and all four arms fold naturally and the full tail coils low, all inside the cell. Keep the royal crest and body exactly the same pixel scale across poses.
